questions.q: Which is the longest and strongest bone in the human body?
questions.qPa: ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਲੰਬੀ ਅਤੇ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ ਹੱਡੀ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The Femur (thigh bone) is the longest and strongest.

questions.q: A muscle contraction where tension is developed but the length of the muscle does NOT change is called:
questions.qPa: ਉਹ ਮਾਸਪੇਸ਼ੀ ਸੁੰਗੜਨ ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਤਣਾਅ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਪਰ ਮਾਸਪੇਸ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਲੰਬਾਈ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲਦੀ, ਉਸਨੂੰ ਕੀ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Isometric ('iso' = same, 'metric' = length) contractions involve no visible movement.

questions.q: How many bones make up the axial skeleton in an adult human?
questions.explanation: The axial skeleton (skull, spine, ribs) consists of 80 bones.

questions.q: The knee joint is an example of which type of joint?
questions.explanation: The knee and elbow are hinge joints, allowing movement primarily in one plane.

questions.q: Which type of muscle tissue is voluntary and used primarily for sports movements?
questions.explanation: Skeletal muscles are attached to the skeleton and are under conscious (voluntary) control.

questions.q: During a bicep curl, when you lower the dumbbell slowly back down, the bicep muscle lengthens under tension. This is an example of:
questions.explanation: An eccentric contraction is a type of isotonic contraction where the muscle lengthens while producing force.

questions.q: The shoulder blade is anatomically known as the:
questions.explanation: The scapula is the shoulder blade.

questions.q: Cardiac muscle is found exclusively in which organ?
questions.explanation: Cardiac muscle is specialized tissue found only in the heart.
